1. **Duplicate `[SR17]` ID.** Trigger: two distinct cases—parameterized expired-access and no-access-token—share the same test ID. Consequence: filtered runs and reports are ambiguous; one scenario can be mistaken for the other. Uncertainty: no runtime failure, and label reuse may be intentional, but traceability is broken.

2. **`[SR05]` does not verify its stated logout behavior.** Trigger: hook shows the ordinary expiry prompt instead of initiating logout after refresh expiry. Consequence: the test still passes because it only asserts `showTimeout === true`, identical to `[SR04]`. Uncertainty: `showTimeout` may itself represent the logout path; implementation is not visible in this segment.
